note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions only: which story chapters and missions come first, which collectibles and counts follow, and in what order to earn them.

stages.text: Play the main story in order, Chapters 1 to 4, and finish the final mission. This earns every chapter trophy, every named-mission trophy and the gold for the final mission. Before the finale, clear the ten missable trophies — they need a partner, a choice or a single moment that may not come back.
stages.title: Stage 1 — Story first

stages.text: Work through the stranger and side strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret's hunt, and three more stranger strands to reach 8 in total for the silver. Check the map for stranger icons between story missions so no strand is left behind.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Strangers & side missions

stages.text: Sweep Leonida for the long counts: all 52 areas, 100 vehicles discovered, 10 registered to Scooter Bros, 18 meditation spots, 100 WAiNK It locations, 3 collectible card sets and all 8 garage properties. Do these while travelling for other goals — exploring once covers several at the same time.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Collectibles & exploration

stages.text: Grind the activities: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 20 different race wins, drone-race wins at all 14 Top Fun locations, a fishing win over Cal, one arcade game, a full bowling game, and 50 challenges along the way. Try each activity type once early for Master of None.
stages.title: Stage 4 — Activities & challenges

stages.text: Clean up the crime, combat and money trophies: bank vaults, armored trucks, gang operations, Combat Focus, the Rhino, the jewelry store, the showroom smash, the melee drive-by and the strange encounter. Spend and launder your way to $100,000 spent and $250,000 laundered. When the last trophy lands, the platinum pops — and the 100% completion gold usually lands here too.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Crime, combat & clean-up
